fusions.name: Gleaning Reap
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 20 damage to a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Crescent Sweep
fusions.desc: Cuts a wide arc ahead of you, dealing 9 damage to everything in it. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Winter Larder
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Harvest Fervour
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
